name: The Hermit Tanner
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
These hides are bound for a tanner who I often trade with. He is something of a hermit and he lives alone on the top of the ridge behind me. Climbing up a steep hillside isn't something I can manage easily right now so I'd be in your debt if you could make this delivery for me.

Oh, and about this tanner's... appearance. You need not be alarmed. In spite of his looks, he is no threat. I swear this is true.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the hermit on the ridge overlooking the Dry Hills in the Barrens.
narrative.offerRewardText: Vrang sent you then? Very well. I appreciate you delivering these hides to me. It's unfortunate that Vrang couldn't make the journey himself. There is a matter I wish to speak with him about.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings, champion. What brings you up to my property today?
